title: SkyrimNet MultiProxy
tagline: Connect your AI of choice to SkyrimNet — set it up once, and it starts every time you play.
description:
SkyrimNet uses AI for much more than conversation: dynamic dialogue, actions, personal diaries, character bios, the GameMaster, Quick decisions, and more. It sends many requests at once. **MultiProxy** sits quietly in the background, catches them all, and sends each one to whichever AI you want handling that job. It installs like a normal program and lives in your system tray.

**Use what you already have:**
* **Subscriptions (no API keys needed):** Your existing Claude, ChatGPT (Codex), Google AI Pro (Antigravity), or SuperGrok account.
* **API keys:** GLM (z.ai), Nano-GPT, OpenAI, DeepSeek, Gemini, xAI, Continuum, Kilo Gateway, and TypeSafe, plus Cloudflare Workers AI, Mistral, and Groq for small free allowances.
* **Your own hardware:** Built-in local models run on your graphics card with no extra program, no key, and no bill. Ollama and LM Studio models show up too.

**What it does for you:**
* **Use your other PCs:** Put the small MultiProxy Courier on a spare PC or laptop and use its models from your gaming PC. It updates itself.
* **Quick decisions and voice:** A fast, private model answers SkyrimNet's constant background questions. NPCs speak with a voice running on your own hardware, and you can talk to them with push-to-talk (speech to text through xAI, off until you turn it on).
* **Routing:** Pick which model answers Dialogue, Combat, Memory, and every other job, with backups if one fails.
* **Starts with Skyrim:** The Skyrim mod starts MultiProxy when your game boots, so there is nothing to click or remember.
* **Easy local dashboard:** Add keys, pick models, test any AI with a quick in-character chat, and see what is running on the Overview page. Every tab has built-in Help.
* **Live Speeds tab:** Real response times and reliability for each AI, and which AI runs each SkyrimNet job.
* **Smooths out rough replies:** Retries dropped calls, cleans up garbled output, and fixes broken tags before SkyrimNet sees them.
author: awesmdiver
changelog:
## Improvements

- **Set me up:** Checks your graphics card and your game, shows which models fit alongside Skyrim, and installs the ones you tick.
- **Add a PC:** Open one address on a spare PC and it pairs itself. No pairing codes to type.
- **One list of every model:** The new **Models** tab shows every model on all your PCs. You can start, stop, remove, or delete them from there.
- **A guard for your game:** If your graphics memory gets too full while Skyrim is running, MultiProxy stops its local chat model to prevent a crash.
- **Works on Skyrim VR:** One mod file now covers Skyrim SE, AE, and VR, and it no longer needs Address Library.
- **and a lot more:** See the full release notes on Github.
